text:
Alex: FYI — planning a prod push for 2.14.0 in the 15:00 UTC change window. Need to confirm who has deploy rights and any MFA/jit gaps.
Marta: thanks — are we using the usual deployer role or the temporary elevated flow?
Alex: prefer deployer role, but there were gaps last week where two deployers were OOO. we might need a temp-grant for QA lead.
Irene: can we do a shadow deploy first? that would reduce blast radius while we sort perms.
Ben: we should also pin service A to v2.14.0 and fallback to v2.13.7 on errors. rollback authorizations? who can trigger?
Marta: policy says anyone in group "deployers" or oncall can rollback. but rollback requires MFA and a note in the release channel.
DeployBot: Deploy request created by @Alex for service-a:v2.14.0 scheduled 2024-11-16T15:00:00Z. Required approvers: 2 deployers or 1 deployer + oncall. MFA enforced.
SRE-Oncall: I'm oncall that day — I can approve/monitor. If we need temporary elevation for @Jia (QA), request via /grant-temp with justification.
Alex: Jia needs push for a hotfix verification step. I'll open a /grant-temp now and tag security.
Marta: tagging @Irene for security sign-off on the justification. remember we need audit logging for any temp grants.
Irene: noted. please include the exact commands Jia will run and the time box. no shell access beyond governor bot.
Ben: to be safe, can we add an automatic canary: 5% traffic to v2.14.0 for 10 minutes, then 50%, then full if no errors? DeployBot supports that via rollout_policy.
Alex: yes, set rollout_policy: {"stages": ["5%:10m","50%:20m","100%:0m"]} — will include in request.
DeployBot: Canary rollout configured. Audit trail will include operator and MFA token.
Marta: who can press the final 'promote' button? clarify: can QA (with temp grant) promote or does it have to be a deployer?
Irene: temp grant allows pushing within the time box but not final promote to 100% unless a deployer or oncall signs off. that's our control.
Ben: ok. let's document this in the release notes and add a short permission matrix in the ticket: who can start, who can pause, who can promote, who can rollback.
Alex: I'll update the ticket and create the temp grant request. tagging @SRE-Oncall for the sign-off step.
SRE-Oncall: approved contingent on canary and audit logging. I'll be available during the window. :thumbsup:
Marta: thanks. one more ask — please verify MFA enrollment for anyone we might grant. last time we had a 2-hour delay because someone wasn't enrolled.
Alex: good call. Jia is enrolled already per identity logs. proceeding to request.
Irene: also add a brief runbook for rollback steps in the ticket: commands, expected metrics to watch, and communication plan to #prod-incidents if things go sideways.
Alex: will do. final checklist: confirm approvers (SRE-Oncall + Marta), temp-grant for Jia with timebox 2h, canary policy added, MFA verified, and rollback runbook attached.
Marta: sounds good. I'll be on hand during the window. :rocket:
